subject: 藏地石砌城门守舍（原创扩展；非具名宗堡复原）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create exactly ONE isolated city-map sprite for tianshu, historical Tibetan regional kit. Realistic ancient material detail and crisp restrained weathering matching the attached Song reference; reinterpret the subject in Tibetan stone/wood/cloth construction, not Chinese gray-tiled gables. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection, yaw45 pitch30, NO perspective convergence. BOTH ground axes MUST form exactly slopes +0.5 and -0.5 in screen space, opposite edges parallel, upright vertical posts. The ground-plane bounding diamond must be twice as wide as high. Thin natural ground contact, clearly visible LEFT, FRONT and RIGHT ground corners; no thick display slab. South/front faces screen lower left. Opaque solid object with real RGBA background transparency; no luminous rim, haze, glow, baked white or checkerboard. Warm-neutral light from screen UPPER LEFT, tiny short soft contact shadow lower right. Entire asset centered with at least10% transparent margins, no cropping. No people, animals, writing, marks resembling lettering, shop signs, watermark, labels, grid, modern elements, background scenery, road, sky, floating island, diorama base, cartoon or toy. Original generic regional adaptation; not a named historical monument. Asset ID bld_kit_tubo_guardhouse. Single modest fortified Tibetan gatekeeper's stone guardhouse,6m east-west by5m north-south footprint, nearly square ground plan and visible edge length ratio1.2. Two storeys, low flat packed-earth roof and simple parapet, slightly inward-tapering rubble-stone walls with patchy off-white plaster, dark small deeply-set trapezoid-framed slit windows, one sturdy dark timber doorway facing lower-left and just two shallow steps. Modest deep-red band under parapet; no palace gold, no tile roof, no outside wall segment and no gate arch. A tiny plain cloth canopy only above door. Not a castle or watchtower cluster; whole standalone guard shelter. For camera calibration the ground rectangle could be projected with LEFT(0.2,0.64), FRONT(0.5273,0.8036), RIGHT(0.8,0.6673), BACK(0.4727,0.5037) relative to canvas; no point labels or drawing of coordinates. Keep the two visible ground edges at slopes+0.5/-0.5.
negative: 人物、动物、文字、现代物、天空、景观、厚展示地台、假透明、透视汇聚、光晕
